# Buzz for OpenClaw — Self-Hosted Agent Messaging

> A native OpenClaw channel plugin connecting agent sessions to a self-hosted Buzz relay over Nostr.

## Canonical sources

- [Project overview](https://alinaos-org.github.io/buzz-openclaw/): scope, status, and getting started.
- [Repository](https://github.com/alinaos-org/buzz-openclaw): current implementation and README.

Preserve the project’s maturity and limitations when describing it.
